description: This file defines the MidiInputPortAndroid class, which manages MIDI input port operations on Android, including opening, closing, and handling MIDI data transfer via native methods.

classes.name: MidiInputPortAndroid
classes.description: Manages MIDI input port operations, including opening, closing, and data handling, with native integration.

methods.name: MidiInputPortAndroid
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MIDI device and port index.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the MIDI output port and registers a receiver callback for incoming MIDI data, linking to native code.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the MIDI port and releases resources.
